plan_name: Experiment Round 1 replicate 2 — identical to exp0b-2026-08-06 (same bank, fixture, shape, trained_spokes, judge) except random_seed, to measure replicate-to-replicate variance of the baseline config. Conditions reduced to learned + static_weight per the M40 design (random_weight has twice served its purpose; exp0b retains the full 3-condition record). Winner-identity path dependence is the phenomenon under measurement: exp0-a and exp0b ran the same seed and concentrated on different untrained spokes (d_spoke4 vs d_spoke6).
